areas.setup: opening hours, open 24 hours, how the facility runs, the booking rules (shortest and longest session, how far ahead, the gap between bookings, bay or time first), members only, the whole building as one space, its name, legal name, location, contact details and time zone, early bay access, the backup passphrase, which AI answers this chat
areas.website: the website's content: the homepage's sections and their words, weekly specials, a food menu section, the top of the page, a notice across the top, undo
areas.events: events on the website: leagues, scrambles, clinics, tournaments - add one, change it, take it off, what is coming up
areas.photos: photos on the website: the photos at the top of the page, the gallery, the slides under the top
areas.flyers: flyers for a deal, package, event or special
areas.pages: the owner's own pages on the website: make one, rename it or put it in the menu, take it off, move a section onto one, the whole site on one page, the how-it-works page
areas.look: the website's look: colours, fonts, the style (buttons, corners, spacing, the top of the page), the logo
areas.site: the website's settings: what is public, the homepage, the menu, social links, search and sharing, contact details, email sign-up, visitor counting, the holding page
areas.online: getting the box online: its address (the domain), whether that domain is on Cloudflare yet, its email records and DNSSEC, connecting the box to the owner's own Cloudflare ("connect my box"), whether the site answers from outside
areas.bays: running the bays now: a whole bay or every bay on or off, one plug, out of service, restart or wake a bay's PC, a frozen bay, what the automation could not do
areas.baysetup: setting the bays up: a bay's PC (its address, wake ID, Windows sign-in), smart plugs (added, renamed, moved), when each device comes on and goes off, how long bays stay on between sessions, the bay watchers, TVs (their BroadLink remotes found, put on a bay, their codes learned from their own remote, taken off), a bay's name and price, adding a bay or naming them all
areas.routines: routines on a bay's PC: taught by clicking through once ("watch me"), run on a hotkey or when a session starts or ends, the PC starts, a program opens or closes or a window appears; a routine's steps, copied to other bays, taken off
areas.smarthome: smart-home devices: pair one, name it, put it on a bay or on the whole facility (the heat and AC, a lounge TV), switch it
areas.staff: staff and the schedule: shifts (add, change, give to someone, open), copying weeks and saved patterns, time off and shift requests, the time clock (who is on, hours, fixes), staff who can sign in
areas.staffing: staffed hours: which days and hours someone is at the counter, the seasons that decide them, switching staffed hours off
areas.money: prices and rates for days and times, prices under the time slots, discount codes, deposits, gift cards, revenue and End of Day, whether Stripe, email and texting are connected, card readers and the tip prompt, refunds made in Stripe
areas.messages: emails, texts, newsletters, the words of the messages customers get, which are sent, the owner's own alerts, the inbox, webhooks (Zapier and the like), STOP replies
areas.bookings: bookings: who is booked, a price for a time, make one at the counter, move one, cancel one (with the refund the owner names), a stuck checkout, block off a bay or the whole building, check-in
areas.menu: the food and drink menu - the counter's, which the servers ring up and the website shows live: its parts (Food, Beer, Wine, Burgers...), items and prices, a line about an item, sold out (86), a new part's tax and where its tickets print
areas.numbers: how the business is doing, in numbers: a period against the same days before it (bookings, hours, how full the bays were, customers new and coming back, money taken, memberships sold, best sellers), one day's bookings (how many, the longest, tomorrow), who is playing now, the tax collected and the tax as a spreadsheet, the tax rates
areas.unit: the unit itself: software updates (check, install now or tonight, undo, an update file BA emailed), files of the records to download (revenue, bookings, staff hours, the year-end report, the email sign-up list)
areas.doors: door codes: which lock they go to, how long before and after a session a code works, when it is texted, whether the lock is checked first

actions.name: schedule_read
actions.does: Look at the staff schedule: who works when, open shifts, requests waiting for you, and hours nobody covers

start.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD (today, tomorrow and a weekday name are understood too)

end.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD (today, tomorrow and a weekday name are understood too)

actions.does: Look at which days have someone at the counter (staffed days)

from.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD (today, tomorrow and a weekday name are understood too)

to.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD (today, tomorrow and a weekday name are understood too)

actions.name: roster_read
actions.does: Look at who is on the staff roster

actions.name: setup_status
actions.does: See which setup steps are done and which are still to do

actions.name: setup_skip
actions.does: Put a setup step off for now when the owner says to skip it ("skip texting", "do the logo later") - it stays on the setup checklist and the box reminds the owner later

actions.name: setup_confirm

actions.name: waiver_mode_set

actions.name: waiver_policy_set

actions.name: site_go_live

actions.name: health_read

actions.name: guide_chapter

topic.description: what it is about, like "text messaging" or "payments"

part.description: which part to read; leave out for the first

actions.name: guide_search
actions.does: Look something up in the BA guide

date.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD (today, tomorrow and a weekday name are understood too)

weekdays.description: days of the week, 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday

start_time.description: a time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock (5pm and 5:30 pm are understood too)

actions.name: announcement_set

actions.name: requests_read

actions.name: request_decide

actions.name: opening_hours_set

open_time.description: a time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock (5pm and 5:30 pm are understood too)

days.description: the days: sat, sun, weekends, fri ...

open_time.description: a time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock (5pm and 5:30 pm are understood too)

close_time.description: a time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock (5pm and 5:30 pm are understood too)

actions.name: website_headline_set
actions.does: Change the big headline at the top of the website, the line under it, or the small tag above it

tag.description: the small line above the headline

actions.name: network_scan
actions.does: Look for the PCs and the Shelly smart plugs on the facility's network (a NEW plug is put on the Wi-Fi with the Shelly app first - tell the owner so if none is found): each PC's address and its own name, each plug's address, model and name, and which bay a plug is on already (so the owner can say which bay each is for)

actions.name: bay_pc_link
actions.does: Link a bay to its PC from the network scan: its wake ID (so the bay can wake it before each session) and, when the PC's Windows ADMIN sign-in is already saved on the bay, its address (so the bay can shut it down after)

address.description: the PC's IPv4 address from the scan

wake_id.description: the PC's MAC address from the scan, if it gave one

pc_name.description: the PC's own name from the scan, for saying it back

actions.name: bay_plug_add
actions.does: Put a Shelly smart plug (found by the network scan) on a bay, so it follows the bay's bookings: on before each session, off after - or, for the plug the bay's PC runs from, left on

address.description: the plug's address from the scan

name.description: what it powers, like "Projector"

generation.description: the plug's generation from the scan

for_pc.description: true when the bay's PC runs from this plug: it is left on after sessions

actions.name: plug_switch
actions.does: Turn a Shelly plug on or off now, to test it - by its address from the scan or its name on a bay

plug.description: the plug's address, or its name on a bay

actions.name: location_set
actions.does: Set the facility's city and state (they are used for the Google listing text), and if the owner gives them its map pin (latitude and longitude, as Google Maps shows when the place is long-pressed)

actions.name: website_address_set
actions.does: Set the website's own address (its domain, used for links and search)

actions.name: access_style_set
actions.does: Set how the facility runs: staffed (someone always at the counter), unstaffed (door codes, nobody at the counter) or hybrid (staffed some hours, door codes otherwise)

actions.name: email_sender_set
actions.does: Set the address the facility's emails come from (the Resend key is pasted into the chat on its own)

actions.name: texting_number_set
actions.does: Set the phone number the facility's texts come from (the Twilio keys are pasted into the chat on their own)

actions.name: event_add
actions.does: Add an event to the website (its own Events page, and the homepage's next-event section): a title, the date, a few words, and a flyer photo or a link if the owner has one - a NEW event only: one already on the website (its time, day or words) is changed with event_edit. The Events page is PUBLIC: only what anyone may come to. One person's, a family's, a team's, a company's or a client's own occasion (a birthday, a retirement, a company outing, "a bash for Mike", "Sarah's 40th", "the Smiths' night") is a private booking - block_add or booking_make - never an event; when you cannot tell which, ask the owner

date.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD (today, tomorrow and a weekday name are understood too)

flyer.description: a photo the owner added in the chat (/uploads/landing/...)

actions.name: tiers_read
actions.does: Look at the membership tiers there are now

actions.name: membership_tier_create
actions.does: Make a new membership tier. Before calling this, ask the owner one question at a time: its name; the monthly price; how many free hours a month it includes (0 for none); the discount on time beyond those hours; which days and hours members may book (or any time); whether members may bring guests, and how many; whether it is sold online

hours_per_month.description: free hours a month included; 0 for none

discount_percent.description: percent off booked time beyond the free hours; 0 for none

days.description: days members may book: mon tue wed thu fri sat sun, weekdays, weekends; leave out for every day

earliest_time.description: a time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock (5pm and 5:30 pm are understood too)

latest_time.description: a time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock (5pm and 5:30 pm are understood too)

price_annual.description: dollars a year, when it is also sold by the year; 0 for not

roster_cap.description: the most members it may have; 0 for no cap

actions.name: base_price_set
actions.does: Set the facility's base price - one price for every bay (memberships and peak prices apply on top; one bay's extra or discount is bay_price_adjust_set) - per half hour, or per hour as the owner said it

per_hour.description: dollars per hour - instead of per half hour, when the owner said it per hour

actions.name: newsletters_read

actions.name: newsletter_send
actions.does: Send a newsletter to everyone signed up for email updates (write it with the owner first; each email carries the person's own unsubscribe link). When nobody is signed up yet, say so plainly - never put up some other change in its place

picture.description: a picture at the top of the email: a special's flyer (special_flyer) or a photo on this unit (/uploads/landing/...)

body.description: the newsletter's message only, plain text; a blank line starts a new paragraph. Each email already starts "Hi <their name>," (when they gave one) and ends "- <the business name>" with their unsubscribe link (services/newsletter.js), so write no greeting and no sign-off

actions.name: backup_passphrase_set
actions.does: Ask the owner for the backup passphrase (copies that leave the unit are encrypted with it) - the chat shows a masked box for it; you never see it

actions.name: website_promo_set
actions.does: Show, hide or change the first-visit offer band on the website (a short label, a title, a line of text, a code to use)

code.description: a discount code the facility already has, to show

actions.name: website_contact_set
actions.does: Set the email and phone shown on the website's Find us section, and whether its map and opening hours show

actions.name: website_steps_set
actions.does: Write the homepage's "how it works" strip: its title and up to four short steps, each a title and a line (the separate How It Works page is edited in Settings > Business & Content)

actions.name: website_page_create
actions.does: Make a new page on the website (like "Leagues" or "Birthday parties") with its words; it shows in the footer once published - a NEW page with its own words. Moving a homepage section onto a page is website_section_to_page; the coming-soon (holding) page's words are website_holding_set

words.description: the page's text; a blank line starts a new paragraph

publish.description: live now, or a draft for the owner to look at first

actions.name: website_look_set

colours.description: a designed colour set: fairway-light, pine-dark, navy-copper, charcoal-red, slate-teal, sand-forest, midnight-ice, plum-gold

actions.name: public_part_set
actions.does: Show or hide a part of the public website: booking, memberships, the member portal, events, gift cards, leagues, or the email sign-up page

actions.name: smarthome_read
actions.does: Look at the smart-home hub and its devices: each device's name, kind (Z-Wave, Zigbee, Matter), what it controls, whether each is on, and which bay it is on

actions.name: smarthome_setup
actions.does: Set up the smart-home hub built into this unit (its Home Assistant and the Z-Wave and Matter radios) - only when the hub says it is not set up - ONLY when the owner asks to set up the hub, or a pairing they asked for needs it; never on your own while answering something else

actions.name: device_pair
actions.does: Pair a new smart-home device with the hub: a Z-Wave or Zigbee plug, switch, light, thermostat or sensor, or a Matter device ALREADY SET UP in its own app (or Apple Home or Google Home) with the code that app shows to share it - a new Matter device goes into its own app first, tell the owner so. kind.description: zwave, zigbee or matter - it says on the device or its box

code.description: a Matter device's sharing code: the 11 digits (or MT:...) its app shows when the owner shares it from the app it was set up in

actions.name: device_name_set
actions.does: Give a smart-home device a name the owner will know, like "Bay 2 Projector" (read the devices first)

device.description: the device's name now, or one of its controls

actions.name: bay_device_add
actions.does: Put a smart-home device on ONE bay so it follows that bay's bookings: power (on a few minutes before each session, off after) or climate (a comfort temperature during sessions, idle after). A thermostat, the heat and AC, or a TV or light for the whole room goes on the facility instead (facility_device_set) - one bay's session ending must never turn those off

device.description: the device's name, or one of its controls (like switch.bay_2_plug)

use.description: power: on before a session, off after; climate: a thermostat

minutes_before.description: power: how many minutes before a session it turns on (10 when not said)

turn_off_after.description: power: off after the session (yes, unless it must stay on - like the plug a PC runs from)

minutes_after.description: power: minutes after the session it turns off (30 when not said)

comfort_temp.description: climate: during sessions (70 when not said)

eco_temp.description: climate: idle while heating (60 when not said)

cool_eco_temp.description: climate: idle while the AC is on (the heating setback mirrored above comfort when not said - 80)

actions.name: bay_device_remove
actions.does: Take a smart-home device off a bay, so it no longer follows the bay's bookings (the device stays paired)

actions.name: facility_device_set
actions.does: Put a smart-home device on the whole facility, or change one already there - the heat and AC (thermostats belong here), a lounge TV, the sign, the lobby lights. It comes on before the first booking in any bay, stays on while the next booking anywhere starts within the gap, and goes to standby (off, or a thermostat to its idle temperature) when nothing is booked inside it - one bay's booking ending never turns it off. Or it follows the opening hours. When setting one up, ask the owner: how early it comes on, and how long a gap between bookings keeps it on (if they have no number: a thermostat three hours, a TV one hour); a thermostat's temperatures

device.description: the device's name, or one of its controls (like climate.lobby)

use.description: power: on and off (a TV, lights, a plug); climate: a thermostat. Left out, a thermostat is climate and anything else power

follows.description: bookings: around the bookings in any bay (the usual); hours: the opening hours, and any booking outside them

minutes_before.description: how early it comes on before the first booking (or opening) - 10 for power, 15 for a thermostat when not said

keep_on_gap.description: minutes: it stays on while the next booking starts within this long after one ends; 0 = standby as soon as each run of bookings ends. A thermostat 180, power 60 when not said

minutes_after.description: minutes after the last booking ends that it goes to standby (10 when not said)

stays_on.description: power only: true = never switched off once on

comfort_temp.description: thermostat: while bookings are on (70 when not said)

idle_heat_temp.description: thermostat: standby while heating, below comfort (60 when not said)

idle_cool_temp.description: thermostat: standby with the AC on, above comfort (the heating standby mirrored above comfort when not said - 80)

actions.name: facility_device_remove
actions.does: Take a device off the whole facility, so it no longer follows the bookings or the hours (it stays paired, and is left as it is now)

device.description: the device's name, or one of its controls

actions.name: thermostat_set
actions.does: Set a thermostat to a temperature now ("set the lobby to 68"). It is set for the mode it is in (heating, cooling, or heat/cool around that number); a thermostat someone switched off is left alone. Its schedule sets it again at its next change

device.description: the thermostat's name, or its control (climate.lobby)

actions.name: device_switch
actions.does: Turn a smart-home device on or off now - a plug, a light, a switch - to test it after pairing, or because the owner asked (never a lock: doors open with codes)

device.description: the device's name, or one of its controls

actions.name: cancellation_window_set
actions.does: Set how many hours before a booking a customer can still cancel it

actions.name: ai_service_read
actions.does: See which AI model answers this chat (the OpenAI or Claude connection the owner saved in Hosted AI settings), whether it is answering, where the owner's requests go, and the model names that service offers. The connection itself is changed only in Admin > Owner Chat > Hosted AI settings

actions.name: website_hero_photos_set
actions.does: Put photos the owner added in the chat at the top of the website (the hero): up to three, in order - the first leads, and is also the picture shown when the site is shared and behind the bay screens between sessions - only for the TOP of the homepage (the big photo); photos for the gallery are website_gallery_add

photos.description: the photos' addresses as the chat gave them, like /uploads/landing/123-bays.jpg

actions.name: website_gallery_add
actions.does: Add photos the owner added in the chat to the website's gallery, each with a short caption (the caption is what a screen reader says) - the gallery section; the photos at the top of the homepage are website_hero_photos_set

actions.name: logo_upload
actions.does: Ask the owner for their logo: the chat shows a button to pick the file (JPG, PNG or WebP), and it becomes the logo on the website and the app icons

actions.name: waiver_upload
actions.does: Ask the owner for their waiver PDF: the chat shows a button to pick it, and it becomes the waiver customers sign (their own document - never write, find or judge one)

actions.name: logo_from_photo
actions.does: Make a photo the owner just added in the chat (its /uploads/landing/... address) the logo - on the website and the app icons. For a logo not added yet, logo_upload

actions.name: bay_watcher_download
actions.does: Build a bay's watcher (the Session Monitor) for the owner to download and install on that bay's PC - one zip per bay, never another bay's

actions.name: bay_pc_signin_set
actions.does: Save a bay PC's Windows ADMIN sign-in, so the bay can shut the PC down after sessions: the user name (Admin unless they say otherwise) and, optionally, the PC's address; the owner types the password in a private box the assistant never sees

user.description: the ADMIN account's Windows user name

address.description: the PC's IPv4 address, when it is known (from the network scan)

actions.name: website_read
actions.does: Look at the website as it is now: what visitors see first, the homepage's sections in order (each with its id, kind, name and whether it shows), the top of the page, the look (colours, fonts, style), the pages, the menu, social links, search words and upcoming events. Read it before changing a section

actions.name: website_check
actions.does: Check the website over before it goes live, or when the owner asks "is my site ready?": what is missing (photos, logo, search words, social links), starter words still in a section, colours that are hard to read, buttons hidden because they point at a part that is not public, and whether it is the homepage yet. Then offer to fix each, one at a time

actions.name: website_section_read
actions.does: Look at everything in one homepage section (all its words and its whole list) before changing part of it

section.description: its id, its name or its title

page.description: when the section is on one of the owner's own pages: that page's title (leave out for the homepage)

actions.name: website_section_add
actions.does: Add a section to the homepage, with its words. Kinds: story (a photo beside words), text (words only), faq (questions and answers), rates (your prices, live), quotes (what players say), video, cta (a band with one button), form (an inquiry form - parties, leagues, lessons), social (your social links), signup (email updates), specials (weekly specials by day), menu (food and drink), cards (coaches, lessons, packages, the simulators), banner (a full-width photo with a headline and a button). When the owner has not said where, ask: right after the top of the page, before or after another section, or near the end (a food or drink special with a price is counter_special_set - it shows in the weekly specials by itself; the email sign-up box everywhere is email_updates_set)

at.description: top = right after the top of the page

before.description: a section to put it above

after.description: a section to put it below

page.description: when the section is on one of the owner's own pages: that page's title (leave out for the homepage)

small_line.description: the small line above the headline

words.description: its main words (a blank line starts a new paragraph)

more_words.description: photo + text only: a second paragraph

photo.description: photo + text or a photo band: a photo the owner added in the chat

link.description: a page like /book, a section like #visit, or https://...

name.description: a special's or a menu item's name

words.description: a quote, or a line about the special, the menu item or the card

days.description: a special's days: every day, weekdays, weekends, or days like "tue" or "thu-sun"

time.description: when a special runs, like "after 6 PM"

photo.description: a photo the owner added in the chat (/uploads/landing/...)

date.description: a special for ONE day only ("tonight", "Friday", a date): its days are not read then, and it is gone after its day

show_also.description: a special: where else it shows on its day - top (it leads the top of the homepage in place of the photo), slides (first in the slides under the top), booking (on the booking page)

items.description: the whole list (replaces it): FAQ - question and answer; testimonials - words and who; weekly specials - days, name, words, price, time, photo; menu - name, price, words; cards - title, words, price, photo, link, link_words

show.description: weekly specials: all of them with today's marked, or only today's

cards_source.description: cards: "packages" shows your package deals live, each with a Book button ("show our packages on the website"); "typed" the cards written here

actions.name: special_place
actions.does: Put a special somewhere else on its day, beside its specials section: the top of the homepage (in place of the photo - the first thing people see, the usual choice for one night), the slides under the top, the booking page. Recommend one and say why, then offer the others

show_also.description: where else it shows on its day: top, slides, booking - empty for its section only

add.description: true: add these places to the ones it has ("also on the booking page"); otherwise they replace them ("try it in the slides instead")

actions.name: special_flyer
actions.does: Make (or remake) a special's flyer - a designed card in the site's own fonts, colours, name and logo, with a photo - and put it first in the slides on its day. Layouts: poster (the photo above, the words on your header colour), bold (your button colour edge to edge, the deal huge), photo (the photo edge to edge, the words over it), clean (light and quiet, the photo framed). Then offer to email it out (newsletter_send with it as the picture)

layout.description: poster unless the owner asks for another: "bolder" or "make the deal big" is bold, "use the photo" is photo, "lighter" or "simpler" is clean

photo.description: a photo the owner added in the chat; left out: the special's own photo, else the first at the top of the homepage

in_slides.description: put it first in the slides on its day (yes unless the owner says not)

actions.name: flyer_make
actions.does: Make a flyer for a booking deal, package, event or special by its name ("a flyer for the Tuesday deal"), or from the owner's own words - first in the homepage slides, with Facebook and Instagram downloads; then offer newsletter_send with it as the picture

about.description: the deal, package, event or special by its name

title.description: only for something not set up

layout.description: poster; "bolder" is bold, "use the photo" is photo, "simpler" is clean

photo.description: a photo the owner added in the chat

actions.name: website_section_move
actions.does: Move a homepage section: to the top (right after the top of the page), to the bottom, up or down one, or above or below another section

page.description: when the section is on one of the owner's own pages: that page's title (leave out for the homepage)

actions.name: website_section_show
actions.does: Show or hide a homepage section (it keeps its words and its place)

page.description: when the section is on one of the owner's own pages: that page's title (leave out for the homepage)

actions.name: website_section_remove
actions.does: Take a section off the homepage, words and all (a built-in part can only be hidden)

page.description: when the section is on one of the owner's own pages: that page's title (leave out for the homepage)

actions.name: website_section_to_page
actions.does: Move a section to a page of its own ("give the menu its own page" - the page is made with the title given and put in the top menu), onto another of the owner's pages, or back onto the homepage. A page of its own suits a part with a lot to say (a long menu, leagues, parties); one page suits a small site

section.description: its id, its name or its title

page.description: when the section is on one of the owner's own pages: that page's title (leave out for the homepage)

to_page.description: where it goes: one of the owner's pages by its title, a NEW page's title (it is made), or "homepage"

in_menu.description: a new page: in the top menu (yes unless the owner says not)

actions.name: website_one_page
actions.does: Put the whole site on one page: the sections of every page of the owner's own come onto the homepage, each page's menu link jumps down the homepage to them, and the pages are kept as drafts (nothing is deleted; "give X its own page" puts one back). Suits a small site

actions.name: website_style_set
actions.does: Change how the site is shaped: a whole look at once (classic: the site as built; modern: pill buttons, round corners, room to breathe; bold: square edges, big capital headings, a solid top bar; minimal: quiet, narrow and still; friendly: soft and rounded), and/or any one place: buttons (standard/square/rounded/pill), buttonText (standard/capitals), corners (standard/square/round), cards (flat/lifted), spacing (standard/compact/airy), width (standard/narrow/wide), textSize (standard/larger/largest), textWeight (standard/light/regular/medium), textLines (standard/closer/relaxed), headingSize (standard/smaller/bigger), headingCase (standard/capitals), headingWeight (standard/regular/semibold/heavy), headingStyle (standard/italic), headingLetters (standard/tight/wide/wider), heroAlign (centred/left), heroHeight (tall/short/full), heroShade (standard/lighter/darker), topBar (over-photo/solid), menuStyle (links/tabs/button), phoneBar (off/on), bookBar (on/off), motion (on/off). The first choice of each is the site as built

heroShade.description: Top of the page: shade over the photo

phoneBar.description: Phones: a bar at the bottom

actions.name: website_colors_set
actions.does: Set the website's own colours (never a bay routine's button on the staff pad - that is routine_when_set), any of them, starting from a designed set when the owner names one: background, shaded_background, cards, lines, text, soft_text, headings, accent, links, buttons, button_text, header, header_text - each as #RRGGBB or a plain name (navy, gold, dark green, charcoal, cream...). The booking pages follow. A hard-to-read pair is said back, never blocked

start_from.description: a designed colour set to start from

actions.name: website_fonts_set
actions.does: Change the site's fonts: a whole set in one word (original: Playfair Display headings, Outfit text (the site as built); clean: one font everywhere (Inter); sporty: Bebas Neue headings, Barlow text; elegant: Cormorant Garamond headings, Lora text; strong: Anton headings, Rubik text; sleek: Space Grotesk headings, Manrope text; warm: Poppins headings, Nunito Sans text; clubhouse: DM Serif Display headings, Source Sans 3 text; signature: Dancing Script headings, Nunito Sans text), or any one face - the headings, the words (text and buttons), the small lines above headings - from the font library; one font everywhere; plain small lines. Script faces are for headings and the small lines only. Heading weight, italics, letter spacing, line spacing, text weight and button capitals are website_style_set; the colour of any words is website_colors_set

text.description: the font for everything a visitor reads, and the buttons - never a script face

small_lines.description: the font for the small line above a heading and the name in the top bar

one_font.description: true: ONE font everywhere - the text font (or the one named in text); false: headings, text and small lines may differ

small_lines_style.description: spaced: wide-spaced CAPITALS (as built); plain: ordinary small text

actions.name: website_hero_set
actions.does: Change the top of the homepage beyond its words: its two buttons (words, where each goes, the second shown or not), the logo in the top bar, and the small "scroll" hint

logo.description: show the logo in the top bar

actions.name: website_social_set
actions.does: Set the facility's social links (they show in the footer and in a Social section): facebook, instagram, tiktok, youtube, x - each a full https:// address, or empty to take it off - and up to six other links with a name

actions.name: website_search_set
actions.does: Set what Google and shared links show: the title, the description (one or two sentences - the city and "golf simulator" said naturally) and the picture when a link is shared - for the whole site, or for one page (homepage, booking page, events, memberships, gift cards, how it works, holding page, or one of the owner's own pages by its title)

page.description: leave out for the whole site

share_photo.description: a photo the owner added in the chat

actions.name: website_menu_set
actions.does: Change the site's menu: show a built-in page (events, memberships, gift cards, how it works, leagues) or one of the owner's pages in the top menu and/or the footer, rename one, add a link of the owner's own (its words and an address), or take one of the owner's own links out

item.description: the built-in page, the owner's page title, or the words of a link

address.description: for a new link of the owner's own: /a-page or https://...

remove.description: take one of the owner's own links out

actions.name: website_page_edit
actions.does: Change one of the owner's own pages (made with website_page_create): its title, its words, published or a draft, in the top menu or the footer

actions.name: website_page_remove
actions.does: Take one of the owner's own pages off the site, words and all

actions.name: website_homepage_set
actions.does: Decide what visitors see at the facility's address: this website as the homepage (the booking page moves to /book - every QR code and link keeps working), or the booking page as the homepage; or switch the website off altogether

actions.name: website_holding_set
actions.does: Set the words of the holding page - what a visitor sees on a part of the site that is not public yet - the coming-soon page a visitor sees on a part that is not public yet ("coming soon", "opening November 15"); never a new page

actions.name: email_updates_set
actions.does: Switch email updates on or off (the sign-up box on the site and the /updates page - people who sign up get the newsletters), and set its words: title, a line, the button; and whether the holding page offers it too - the sign-up for our emails, everywhere it shows, is this - not a new section

actions.name: website_analytics_set
actions.does: Count the site's visitors with Google Analytics (an id like G-XXXXXXXXXX) and/or the Meta pixel (8 to 20 digits) - or stop (an empty id). The site tells visitors it counts visits; it never reads bookings or payments

actions.name: website_words_set
actions.does: Change the words of a built-in homepage section: the memberships section (its small line, title and a line under it) or the staffed days section (its title, the line about staffed days, and the line about self-service hours)

words.description: memberships: the line under the title; staffed days: the line about staffed days

self_service_words.description: staffed days only: the line about self-service hours

actions.name: website_history_read
actions.does: See the earlier versions kept of one part of the website (each save keeps the one it replaced; the newest thirty)

actions.name: website_undo
actions.does: Undo the last change to one part of the website (the version saved before it comes back; undo again to redo)

actions.name: events_read
actions.does: Look at the website's events: the upcoming ones with their dates, and how many are past

actions.name: event_edit
actions.does: Change an event on the website: its title, date, words, flyer photo or link (read the events first) - never add a second event for it (event_add is for a new one). The Events page is PUBLIC: a new title that makes it one person's, a family's, a company's or a client's own occasion is a private booking, never an event - ask the owner when you cannot tell. A new start time goes in its words as the owner said it (with am or pm)

event.description: its title (and date if two share a title)

date.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD (today, tomorrow and a weekday name are understood too)

flyer.description: a photo the owner added in the chat

actions.name: event_remove
actions.does: Take an event off the website

actions.name: website_slides_read
actions.does: Look at the offer slides under the top of the homepage (each one's number, small label, title, words, whether it has a photo and whether it is shown) and the gallery's photos (each one's number and caption)

actions.name: website_slide_set
actions.does: Add an offer slide or change one (by its number - website_slides_read): its small label, title, words, a photo the owner added in the chat, whether it is shown, or where it sits (move_to). The page shows the first five shown slides

slide.description: the slide's number; leave out to add a new one

photo.description: a photo's address as the chat gave it

no_photo.description: true takes the slide's photo off

move_to.description: the place it moves to (1 = first)

actions.name: website_slide_remove
actions.does: Take an offer slide off for good, by its number (to keep it but not show it, website_slide_set with shown false)

actions.name: website_gallery_photo_set
actions.does: Change one of the gallery's photos, by its number (website_slides_read): its caption (what a screen reader says), where it sits (move_to), or take it off (remove)

photo.description: the photo's number in the gallery

actions.name: bay_read
actions.does: Look at every bay right now in one go: whether a session is on and until when, the next one today, in or out of service, its PC (address, wake ID, Windows sign-in saved or not, answering or not), its plugs, TV remotes and smart-home devices with their timing, the routines on its PC and when each runs, and anything that went wrong. Use this first for any question about the bays ("what happens on bay 2 when a session starts"); give a bay to see just that one in full

bay.description: one bay to look at in full; leave out for every bay

actions.name: bay_switch
actions.does: Turn a WHOLE bay on or off now, exactly as at the start or the end of a session: on wakes its PC and switches on its plugs, TV and smart-home devices; off shuts its PC down first, then switches the rest off. For one plug use plug_switch; for one smart-home device, device_switch; to restart a PC, bay_pc_restart - never this

on.description: true to turn the bay on, false to turn it off

actions.name: all_bays_switch
actions.does: Turn EVERY bay on or off now, each exactly as at the start or the end of a session - for opening up or closing down the building

on.description: true for every bay on, false for every bay off

actions.name: bay_service_set
actions.does: Take a bay out of service (broken or being repaired: customers cannot book it and its equipment stays off, with no end date) or put it back in service. For a few hours or days, a block on the bookings side fits better

in_service.description: false to take the bay out of service, true to put it back

actions.name: bay_pc_restart
actions.does: Restart a bay's PC now with a normal Windows restart (the game closes; back in about 2 minutes) - when the simulator software misbehaves. For a frozen PC that will not restart, bay_power_cycle

actions.name: bay_pc_wake
actions.does: Wake just a bay's PC now (Wake-on-LAN), without switching on the rest of the bay. For the whole bay, bay_switch

actions.name: bay_power_cycle
actions.does: Cut a bay's power for about 8 seconds and turn it back on (every smart plug on the bay) - only when its PC is frozen and a normal restart (bay_pc_restart) does not work

actions.name: bay_close_override_set
actions.does: Keep a bay's PC on past closing tonight: skip the closing-time PC shutdown once (it resets itself after) - or cancel that

skip_closing_shutdown.description: true to keep the PC on past closing once, false to cancel that

actions.name: automation_read
actions.does: See what the automation could not do in the last two days: plugs, TVs and smart-home devices that did not switch, PC wake-ups, shutdowns and restarts, door codes and texts that failed or were missed - per bay and session time, each with a job code to try it again

bay.description: just this bay; leave out for all

actions.name: automation_retry
actions.does: Try a failed automation job again now - by its job code from automation_read, or every failed job on one bay

job.description: the job code from automation_read, like a3f9c1

bay.description: instead of a job code: every failed job on this bay

actions.name: bay_timing_set
actions.does: Change the Shutdown & Warning Timing for all bays: whether PCs are shut down after sessions, whether a PC left on is restarted before the next group, how long bays stay on between back-to-back sessions, how long turning a bay off waits for its PC, and when the on-screen warning shows before the end

auto_shutdown.description: shut each bay's PC down after its sessions

restart_before_next_group.description: restart a PC left on, 10 minutes before the next group

keep_on_between_sessions_minutes.description: bays stay on through a gap shorter than this between sessions (30 when never changed) - "leave a bay on when another group comes within an hour" is 60

bay_off_waits_seconds.description: how long turning a bay off waits for its PC to shut down (90 when never changed)

warning_minutes.description: minutes before a session ends that the on-screen warning shows (10 when never changed)

actions.name: bay_device_timing_set
actions.does: Change when one device on a bay comes on before each session and goes off after it - a plug, a TV remote, a smart-home device or thermostat, or the PC's wake-up (say "PC") - or whether it is left on after

device.description: the device's name or address on that bay, or "PC" for the PC's wake-up

minutes_before.description: minutes before each session it comes on, at least 1 (a thermostat: starts warming or cooling)

turn_off_after.description: false to leave it on after sessions (like the plug a PC runs from)

minutes_after.description: minutes after each session it goes off - at least 5 for a plug or a TV (a thermostat: goes to its idle temperature, 0 for at once)

eco_temp.description: a thermostat: degrees when idle and heating

cool_eco_temp.description: a thermostat: degrees when idle with the AC on

actions.name: bay_plug_remove
actions.does: Take a Shelly smart plug off a bay, so it no longer follows the bay's sessions (the plug itself is left as it is)

actions.name: bay_ir_test
actions.does: Send a bay TV's learned on or off code now, to test it - only for a TV whose remote has separate on and off buttons ("try the TV's on code", "does the TV come on")

device.description: the TV remote's name or address on that bay

on.description: true for the on code, false for the off code

actions.name: tv_remote_find
actions.does: Look for the BroadLink TV remotes (the small IR boxes that switch TVs and projectors) on the facility's network, and which bays each is on already

actions.name: bay_tv_add
actions.does: Put a TV or projector on a bay through a BroadLink TV remote (tv_remote_find finds them): once its code is learned it comes on before each session and goes off after

name.description: what it switches, like "TV" or "Projector"

separate_buttons.description: true only when the TV's own remote has separate ON and OFF buttons (most have one power button)

turn_off_after.description: false to leave it on after sessions

actions.name: bay_tv_learn
actions.does: Learn a bay TV's code from its own remote: the owner taps Apply, then points the remote at the BroadLink and presses the button within a few seconds. One power button: learned once, for on and off. Separate buttons: ON and OFF one at a time - not to test a code already learned (that is bay_ir_test)

device.description: the TV's name or the BroadLink's address on that bay

button.description: "power" for a remote with one power button; "on" or "off" for one with separate buttons (left out: the one still missing)

actions.name: bay_tv_remove
actions.does: Take a TV (its BroadLink TV remote) off a bay, with its learned codes - it no longer switches with the bay's sessions

device.description: the TV's name or the BroadLink's address on that bay

actions.name: bay_device_set
actions.does: Rename a smart plug or a TV on a bay, change its network address (a plug or a BroadLink that moved), or say whether a TV's own remote has separate ON and OFF buttons

device.description: the plug's or TV's name or address on that bay

name.description: its new name

separate_buttons.description: a TV: true when its own remote has separate ON and OFF buttons, false for one power button

actions.name: routines_read
actions.does: See the routines taught on the bays' PCs - each one's steps in words, when it runs, how its last runs went - and a teaching waiting for the PC or come back with its steps

bay.description: just this bay; leave out for all

actions.name: routine_teach
actions.does: Start teaching a routine on a bay's PC: the owner clicks through it there once (the watcher records the clicks, the words under them, Enter and the like - never letters typed), then names it and says when it runs

name.description: what it does, like "Start GSPro" or "Uneekor sign-in"

program.description: instead of a routine: only show the PC a program a copied routine opens (its name, like "GSPro.exe" - routines_read says which a bay's PC has not been shown)

actions.name: routine_save
actions.does: Save the steps a bay PC sent back from teaching as a routine, with when it runs: when a session starts, when the PC starts, when a program opens or closes, when a window appears, on a hotkey, from the staff pad - or only when asked - this is the save after "watch me" (routine_teach): never routine_create for those steps

name.description: its name (left out: the name it was taught under)

replaces.description: the routine these steps replace, when it was taught again

colour.description: its button colour on the staff pad: a plain name (green, red, navy, gold ...) or #RRGGBB

on_session_start.description: run it when each session on the bay starts (after its PC wakes)

minutes_before_session.description: with on_session_start: how many minutes before each session it runs (left out: 5)

on_session_end.description: run it when each session on the bay ends - to set the bay back for the next player (it runs before the next session's own routine)

every_day_at.description: run it every day at these times, like ["3:00 AM"] or ["9:00", "21:30"] ([] for none)

on_windows_start.description: run it when the bay PC starts up and signs in

when_program_opens.description: run it when this program opens on the PC, like "GSPro.exe"

when_program_closes.description: run it when this program closes - to keep it running, like "Connector.exe"

when_window_appears.description: run it when a window with these words in its title appears, like "Sign in"

hotkey.description: a hotkey on the PC: two of Ctrl, Alt and Shift with one more key, like "Ctrl+Alt+1" ("" for none)

staff_pad.description: whether staff can run it from the staff pad (yes unless the owner says not)

actions.name: routine_when_set
actions.does: For a routine that is there already (routines_read; a new one from steps the owner says is routine_create): change it: when it runs (when a session starts - and how many minutes before - when a session ends, every day at a time, when the PC starts, when a program opens or closes, when a window appears, its hotkey, the staff pad), its name, its button colour on the staff pad, or pause it (nothing starts it but the owner) and resume it

colour.description: its button colour on the staff pad: a plain name (green, red, navy, gold ...), #RRGGBB, or "none"

paused.description: true pauses it (no trigger starts it, it leaves the staff pad), false runs it again

on_session_start.description: run it when each session on the bay starts (after its PC wakes)

minutes_before_session.description: with on_session_start: how many minutes before each session it runs (left out: 5)

on_session_end.description: run it when each session on the bay ends - to set the bay back for the next player (it runs before the next session's own routine)

every_day_at.description: run it every day at these times, like ["3:00 AM"] or ["9:00", "21:30"] ([] for none)

on_windows_start.description: run it when the bay PC starts up and signs in

when_program_opens.description: run it when this program opens on the PC, like "GSPro.exe"

when_program_closes.description: run it when this program closes - to keep it running, like "Connector.exe"

when_window_appears.description: run it when a window with these words in its title appears, like "Sign in"

hotkey.description: a hotkey on the PC: two of Ctrl, Alt and Shift with one more key, like "Ctrl+Alt+1" ("" for none)

staff_pad.description: whether staff can run it from the staff pad (yes unless the owner says not)

actions.name: routine_step_set
actions.does: Change one step of a routine: click it by its words (wait for them to show) or by its spot, how long a wait is, take a step out, or add a wait, a key press or the PC's kept password after a step

step.description: the step's number from routines_read (0 to add one at the start)

seconds.description: a wait's seconds; for a click by its words, how long to wait for them

keys.description: the key to add, like "enter" or "ctrl+s"

password_name.description: the name a password is kept under on the PC

text.description: words to type (never a password - those are kept on the PC)

program.description: a program to close, like "GSPro.exe" (one shown on that PC)

actions.name: routine_run
actions.does: Run a routine on its bay's PC now - the PC does the clicks within about ten seconds

actions.name: routine_copy
actions.does: Copy a routine to other bays (or every other bay): the same steps, when it runs and its colour. A program it opens must be shown once on each of those bays' PCs (routine_teach with program)

to.description: the bays to copy it to, or ["all"] for every other bay

replace.description: replace a routine of the same name on those bays

actions.name: routine_create
actions.does: Make a routine from words alone when it clicks nothing and opens nothing: close a program, press keys, wait, wait for a window, type words, or type a password kept on the PC - with when it runs and its colour. Anything with a click or a program to open is taught on the PC (routine_teach) - a NEW routine from steps the owner says; the steps a bay PC sent back after "watch me" are saved with routine_save

name.description: what it does, like "Close GSPro"

seconds.description: wait: seconds; wait_window: how long to wait for it

password_name.description: password: the name it is kept under on the PC

colour.description: its button colour on the staff pad: a plain name or #RRGGBB

on_session_start.description: run it when each session on the bay starts (after its PC wakes)

minutes_before_session.description: with on_session_start: how many minutes before each session it runs (left out: 5)

on_session_end.description: run it when each session on the bay ends - to set the bay back for the next player (it runs before the next session's own routine)

every_day_at.description: run it every day at these times, like ["3:00 AM"] or ["9:00", "21:30"] ([] for none)

on_windows_start.description: run it when the bay PC starts up and signs in

when_program_opens.description: run it when this program opens on the PC, like "GSPro.exe"

when_program_closes.description: run it when this program closes - to keep it running, like "Connector.exe"

when_window_appears.description: run it when a window with these words in its title appears, like "Sign in"

hotkey.description: a hotkey on the PC: two of Ctrl, Alt and Shift with one more key, like "Ctrl+Alt+1" ("" for none)

staff_pad.description: whether staff can run it from the staff pad (yes unless the owner says not)

actions.name: routine_remove
actions.does: Remove a routine from a bay (its PC stops running it on any trigger)

actions.name: bay_details_set
actions.does: Rename a bay, or change its tagline or the feature chips shown for it on the booking page

name.description: the bay's new name

description.description: its tagline on the booking page

features.description: short feature chips, like "GSPro", "Couch seating", "Left-handed friendly"

actions.name: bay_price_adjust_set
actions.does: Charge more (a premium bay) or less for one bay, per half hour on top of the regular rates, when a customer picks that bay - 0 for no difference

dollars_per_half_hour.description: dollars added per half hour; a minus number for a cheaper bay; 0 for none

actions.name: bays_list_set
actions.does: Set the facility's bays all at once, in order, when the owner says how many bays there are or names them ("we have 4 bays: Bay 1, Bay 2, Bay 3 and The Vault"): the bays there now are renamed in order and the rest are added, bookable at once. Never takes a bay away (that is bay_remove)

names.description: every bay's name in order - "Bay 1", "Bay 2", ... when the owner said only how many

actions.name: bay_add
actions.does: Add a new bay to the facility - customers can book it straight away, unless the owner says it is not ready yet

name.description: the new bay's name, like "Bay 5"

description.description: its tagline on the booking page

ready.description: false to add it out of service until it is ready; true or left out: bookable now

actions.name: messages_settings_read
actions.does: See the messages customers get and how: each one by text and by email, on or off, in the owner's own words or the product's; when the reminder goes; whether texting and email are set up; the name texts are signed with; where replies and urgent alerts go. Use it first when the owner asks about their messages

actions.name: message_words_read
actions.does: Read the words of one message customers get (a text or an email): the owner's own words or the product's, an example exactly as a customer gets it, and the placeholders it fills in (like [Bay] and [Start]). Read it before changing the words

message.description: which message: confirmation_text (sent when a booking is made), reminder_text, door_code_text, cancellation_text, ending_warning_text (15 minutes before the end, nobody booked after), next_group_warning_text (15 minutes before the end, the next group waiting); the emails: confirmation_email, reminder_email, door_code_email, cancellation_email, member_welcome_email, member_payment_failed_email, membership_ended_email, membership_cancelled_email, waiver_renewal_email

actions.name: message_words_set
actions.does: Change the words of one message customers get (a text or an email), or put the product's own words back. Placeholders like [Bay], [Date] and [Start] fill in for each booking (message_words_read lists each message's); the door code messages must keep [Code]; the "Reply STOP" line is added to every text by itself, so leave it out

message.description: which message: confirmation_text (sent when a booking is made), reminder_text, door_code_text, cancellation_text, ending_warning_text (15 minutes before the end, nobody booked after), next_group_warning_text (15 minutes before the end, the next group waiting); the emails: confirmation_email, reminder_email, door_code_email, cancellation_email, member_welcome_email, member_payment_failed_email, membership_ended_email, membership_cancelled_email, waiver_renewal_email

words.description: the new words; a text is best kept to a line or two

use_default.description: true to put the product's own words back

actions.name: message_switch_set
actions.does: Turn one kind of customer message on or off, by text, by email or both: the booking confirmation, the reminder, the door code, the cancellation notice, the 15-minute warning before a session ends, or the email when staff move a booking

message.description: confirmation, reminder, door_code, cancellation, session_ending (the 15-minute warning), booking_changed (the email when staff move a booking - email only)

actions.name: reminder_timing_set
actions.does: Set how long before a session the reminder goes out - one timing for the reminder text and the reminder email (15 minutes to 24 hours)

minutes.description: minutes before the session: 60 is an hour, 120 two hours, 1440 a day

actions.name: owner_alert_mobile_set
actions.does: Set the owner's own mobile number for urgent alerts (door and lock problems, a member's door access failing, a refund Stripe refused, a bay PC not coming up) - never shown to customers; or stop the alert texts

none.description: true to stop the alert texts

actions.name: email_signups_count
actions.does: Count how many people are signed up for email updates (who get the newsletters) - a number only, never their addresses

actions.name: newsletter_cancel
actions.does: Stop a newsletter that is going out right now: the people it has not reached yet will not get it

subject.description: words from its subject - needed only when more than one is going out

actions.name: inbox_read
actions.does: Read the website inbox: what visitors sent through the inquiry form (parties, leagues, questions) - who, when, what about and the first words (on the box's own AI also their email and phone). The new ones, unless the owner asks for all

include_handled.description: true to show the ones already marked handled too

actions.name: inbox_mark
actions.does: Mark a website inbox message handled (or back to new) - by its number from the inbox, or who it is from

inquiry.description: the inquiry_id from inbox_read, or the name of who wrote

handled.description: false to put it back to new; leave out to mark it handled

actions.name: webhook_read
actions.does: See the outbound webhook: the address events are sent to (like a Zapier hook), which events, whether customers' contact details go with them, whether deliveries are signed, and whether the last delivery worked

actions.name: webhook_set
actions.does: Set the outbound webhook: the address to send events to (like a Zapier hook), which events, and whether customers' names, phone numbers and emails go with them; or stop sending. The signing secret is typed on the Outbound Webhooks card, never here

events.description: which to send (the others stop): booking.created (new bookings), booking.changed (moved or extended), booking.cancelled, checkin.completed, member.joined, giftcard.purchased; leave out to keep them as they are

contact_details.description: whether customers' names, phone numbers and emails go with each event; leave out to keep it as it is

actions.name: text_stops_read
actions.does: See how many people texted STOP (they get no texts from this unit until they text START), or whether one phone number did - use it when a customer says they are not getting texts

phone.description: a customer's phone number, to check that one

actions.name: price_windows_read
actions.does: Look at the booking prices: the base price and every price window (days, times and price per half hour, like a weekend or happy hour rate), in the order they are checked

actions.name: price_window_add
actions.does: Add a price window: a price for certain days and hours, like "Friday and Saturday 6 PM to midnight is $30 a half hour" or "happy hour weekdays 2 to 5 is $15". Get the days, the from and to times and the price first - a NEW window only: a window that is there already (its price, days or times) is changed with price_window_change, never added again

name.description: a short name, like "Weekend nights" or "Happy hour"

days.description: the days in words, like "weekdays", "fri, sat", "mon-thu", "weekends" or "every day"

end_time.description: when it ends, HH:MM (00:00 for midnight)

price_per_hour.description: dollars per hour - instead of per half hour, if that is how the owner said it

actions.name: price_window_change
actions.does: Change a price window: its price, days, times or name, or make it win where it overlaps another window (read the windows first for their names). Everything not mentioned stays as it is - for a window that is there already (read them first: price_windows_read); a new one is price_window_add

price_per_hour.description: instead of per half hour, if that is how the owner said it

days.description: the days in words, like "weekdays", "fri, sat", "mon-thu", "weekends" or "every day"

start_time.description: a time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock (5pm and 5:30 pm are understood too)

wins.description: true to make this window's price win where it overlaps others (a window lying wholly inside it still keeps its own)

actions.name: price_window_remove
actions.does: Delete a price window for good, so its days and times go back to the base price (or to another window that covers them)

actions.name: slot_prices_show
actions.does: Show or hide the price under each time slot on the booking page

actions.name: discount_codes_read
actions.does: Look at the discount codes: what each gives, how many times it has been used, its limits, when it expires and whether it is on. Codes cannot be edited once made - only switched off

actions.name: discount_code_create
actions.does: Make a discount code customers type when they book: a percent off (100 for a free booking), dollars off, or free minutes. Ask how many times it can be used, how many times per person, and when it ends, if the owner has not said - never fill in a limit or an end they did not say

code.description: what customers type, like SPRING20 (letters, numbers, - and _)

kind.description: percentage: a percent off; fixed: dollars off; free_minutes: minutes of play free

value.description: the percent, the dollars or the minutes

max_uses.description: how many times it can be used in all; leave out for no limit

per_person.description: how many times one person (one phone number) can use it; 0 for no limit; 1 when not said

expires.description: the last day it works (YYYY-MM-DD); leave out for never

description.description: a note for the owner, like "Spring promo"

check_at_door.description: what staff check at the door: "a military ID"

actions.name: discount_code_off
actions.does: Switch a discount code off so it stops working at checkout (also the way to "change" one: switch it off and make a new code with another name)

actions.name: deposit_set
actions.does: Turn the booking deposit on or off: instead of paying in full online, non-member customers pay a deposit per half hour and settle the rest at the door (only where someone is at the door)

per_half_hour.description: dollars of deposit per half hour; leave out to keep the amount set now

actions.name: gift_card_issue
actions.does: Issue a gift card by hand. Ask the owner whether it was paid for (sold - it counts as money taken in the revenue report) or free (a prize or a comp) - never guess. It can be emailed to the person

sold.description: true when someone paid for it (it counts as money taken today); false for a free card - a prize, a comp, a replacement

email.description: the email to send the card to; leave out to not email it

note.description: a short message, shown in the email

actions.name: gift_cards_read
actions.does: See how many gift cards are out and how much unspent money is on them

actions.name: gift_card_switch_off
actions.does: Switch off a lost or stolen gift card so nobody can spend it, by the last four characters of its code

ending.description: the last four characters of the card's code

actions.name: revenue_read
actions.does: See the money that came in for a period - revenue (money actually taken, minus refunds), how it came in, tax, tips, card fees - plus the sessions played and how busy it was. Use period, or from and to for any other dates

period.description: one of: today, yesterday, this_week, last_week, last_7_days, this_month, last_month, this_quarter, last_quarter, this_year, last_year (this_month when not said)

from.description: the first day, for any other range (YYYY-MM-DD)

to.description: the last day (today when not said; the same as from for one day)

actions.name: day_review_read
actions.does: See the day's comps, voids and refunds for the owner's review - each one: what, how much, who did it and why - and which are not signed off yet

date.description: the day (YYYY-MM-DD, yesterday, or a weekday name - the latest one); today when not said

actions.name: day_review_sign_off
actions.does: Sign off the day's comps, voids and refunds the owner has looked at - all those not yet signed off, or one by its words (the item, or a refund's reason). Read them with day_review_read and say them first. Today or yesterday

day.description: today unless the owner says yesterday

item.description: one of them by its words; leave out for all not yet signed off

actions.name: end_of_day_read
actions.does: See the counter's End of Day for a day: sales by category, payments by card, cash and check, tips, refunds, comps and voids, and the cash that should be in the drawer

date.description: the day (YYYY-MM-DD, yesterday, or a weekday name - the latest one); today when not said

actions.name: membership_tier_change
actions.does: Change a membership tier: its monthly or yearly price, free hours a month, discount beyond the free hours, the days and times members may book, guests, whether it is sold online, its description or name - or bring back a retired tier. Everything not mentioned stays as it is

price_monthly.description: dollars a month; 0 = not offered monthly

price_annual.description: dollars a year; 0 = not offered yearly

free_hours_a_month.description: free hours a month (used before anything is charged); 0 takes free hours away

discount_percent.description: percent off booked time beyond the free hours (or off all booked time when there are none); 0 for none

days.description: the days members may book, in words, like "weekdays", "mon-thu", "fri, sat" or "every day"

earliest_time.description: a time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock (5pm and 5:30 pm are understood too)

latest_time.description: members' sessions must start before this (HH:MM)

any_time.description: true to take away the time limits

guests_per_visit.description: how many guests a member may bring each visit

sell_online.description: shown on the memberships page for people to join online

bring_back.description: true to offer a retired tier again

actions.name: membership_tier_pricing_set
actions.does: Change HOW a membership tier prices members' golf. The styles: "discount" (a percent off, or dollars off each booking; the discount can cover only so many hours a day, week or month), "free_hours" (free hours a month, which may be spread so no more than so many are used a day or a week), "daily_free" (free hours each day, with weekly or monthly pools if wanted) or "flat_rate" (members pay a set rate an hour in place of the regular price). Past their free time or limits members pay: the regular price, a percent off, or a flat rate an hour. Free time is always used first. Say it back in plain words

style.description: left out: the tier keeps its style

dollars_off.description: discount: dollars off each booking instead of a percent

free_hours_a_month.description: free_hours: the free hours each month

free_hours_a_day.description: daily_free: the free hours each day

flat_rate_per_hour.description: flat_rate: dollars an hour members pay

limit_hours_a_day.description: discount: the discount covers up to this a day; free_hours: no more free time than this a day (0 = no limit)

limit_hours_a_week.description: the same a week (daily_free: a weekly pool of free time)

limit_hours_a_month.description: discount: the discount covers up to this a month; daily_free: a monthly pool

after.description: what members pay past their free time or limits

after_value.description: percent_off: the percent; flat_rate: dollars an hour

actions.name: membership_tier_guests_set
actions.does: Change a membership tier's guest rules: whether members may bring guests and how many a visit; guests covered on every visit; a monthly pool of guest passes on top; what a covered guest pays (free, their regular share of the bay at the counter, a flat fee, or their share less a percent); what a guest past the passes pays; whether guest fees are per visit or per hour; and where they are collected (with the member's golf, always online, or at the counter when someone is there)

max_per_visit.description: the most guests a visit (0 = no cap)

passes_a_month.description: a monthly pool of covered guests on top (0 = none; with none included either, every guest is covered)

covered_guests_pay.description: free; share = their regular share of the bay at the counter; flat = a fee each; percent_off = their share less a percent

covered_value.description: flat: dollars each; percent_off: the percent

after_passes_price.description: dollars each for a guest past the passes (0 = free on free or flat, the regular share on share)

charged.description: whether guest fees are per guest per visit or per guest per hour

actions.name: membership_tier_rules_set
actions.does: Change a membership tier's rules: the most members it may have, how many upcoming bookings a member may hold, how many days ahead members may book, which bays they may book, how members' golf is paid (charged online at booking, a deposit online with the rest at the door, or all at the door), the deposit, family codes included, the grace days after a missed payment, and food and drink perks at the counter

member_cap.description: the most members on it (0 = no cap)

bays.description: the bays members may book, by name; ["all"] for every bay

settles.description: online: charged at booking; deposit: a deposit online, the rest at the door; door: nothing online

family_codes.description: member codes included (1 = just the member)

grace_days.description: days a member keeps access after a missed payment

food_off.description: a food discount at the counter

drink_off.description: a drink discount at the counter

actions.name: membership_tier_retire
actions.does: Retire a membership tier nobody active is on any more: it comes off the memberships page and cannot be given to anyone (to only stop selling it online, use membership_tier_change with sell_online false)

actions.name: members_read
actions.does: Look at the members: how many there are by tier and status, and a list (name, tier, status, joined, billing). Narrow it by tier, status or name

status.description: active when not said; inactive means ended

actions.name: members_report_read
actions.does: See the membership numbers: active members, billed online or by hand, past due, the monthly membership value, joins in the last 30 days, members by tier, and member hours this month

actions.name: members_growth_read
actions.does: Who signed up as a member in a period (this week, this month, this year...) and how that compares with the period before and with the same days a year before, the membership money paid and by how many members, and how many members are active now. For "did anyone sign up", "new members", "do we have more members than last year", "are we growing"

period.description: one of: today, yesterday, this_week, last_week, last_7_days, this_month, last_month, this_quarter, last_quarter, this_year, last_year (this_month when not said; this_year for "than last year")

actions.name: member_usage_read
actions.does: See how much a member has played: hours today, this week and this month, guests this month, their last visits, and the free time left on their tier

member.description: the member's name (as the owner says it, or as a list gave it, like "Brian S." - add its #number when two share a name)

actions.name: member_status_set
actions.does: Suspend a member (their PIN stops working until they are switched back on) or reactivate a suspended or ended member

member.description: the member's name (as the owner says it, or as a list gave it, like "Brian S." - add its #number when two share a name)

status.description: suspended to pause them, active to switch them back on

actions.name: member_tier_move
actions.does: Move a member to another membership tier (their benefits change at once)

member.description: the member's name (as the owner says it, or as a list gave it, like "Brian S." - add its #number when two share a name)

tier.description: the tier to move them to

actions.name: membership_cancel
actions.does: Cancel a member's membership. Ask the owner whether it ends now or at the end of the period they have paid for - never guess. Nothing is paid back either way

member.description: the member's name (as the owner says it, or as a list gave it, like "Brian S." - add its #number when two share a name)

actions.name: membership_extend
actions.does: Extend a membership you manage by hand (not billed online) through a date - it also switches an ended one back on

member.description: the member's name (as the owner says it, or as a list gave it, like "Brian S." - add its #number when two share a name)

through.description: the last day of the membership (YYYY-MM-DD)

actions.name: member_add
actions.does: Add a member by hand (no card is charged - the owner collects from them). Needs their name, phone number and tier; email if they have one. The unit makes their PIN and shows it to the owner on their page (never to you)

name.description: their full name

actions.name: member_new_pin
actions.does: Give a member a new PIN (a lost or shared one): the old PIN stops working at once, and the new one shows to the owner on their page (never to you)

member.description: the member's name (as the owner says it, or as a list gave it, like "Brian S." - add its #number when two share a name)

actions.name: member_details_set
actions.does: Correct a member's name, phone number or email

member.description: the member's name (as the owner says it, or as a list gave it, like "Brian S." - add its #number when two share a name)

name.description: their name as it should be

actions.name: bookings_read
actions.does: Look at the bookings for a day or a few days, or a customer's upcoming bookings by name: the time, bay, length, the customer, how it was paid and what is due at the door, and today who has come in, checked in or not shown up. Use it before cancelling, moving or clearing one

date.description: the day (YYYY-MM-DD; today, tomorrow and a weekday name work too); today when left out

days.description: how many days from that day (1 when left out)

name.description: only this customer (their first name, last name or both); with no date, their upcoming bookings

actions.name: booking_quote
actions.does: See what a session would cost and which bays are free at a time - before booking a customer in, or when the owner asks what a time costs

date.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD (today, tomorrow and a weekday name are understood too)

minutes.description: how long, in minutes (60 for an hour)

bay.description: one bay; every bay when left out

actions.name: booking_make
actions.does: Book a customer in yourself (someone who called or walked in): their name and phone (the confirmation goes there), the day, time, length and bay. name.description: the customer's name

email.description: their email, if they gave one

texts_ok.description: true only when the customer agreed to get texts

date.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD (today, tomorrow and a weekday name are understood too)

time.description: the start time (HH:MM, on the hour or half hour)

minutes.description: how long, in minutes (60 for an hour)

package.description: a package deal they are booking, by its name (its length and price are the package's)

players.description: how many players, for a package

actions.name: booking_move
actions.does: Move a confirmed booking to another day, start time or bay (its length and price stay the same). Find it by its day and its time, bay or the customer's name; say where it goes with to_date, to_time and/or to_bay

date.description: the day the booking is on now

name.description: the customer's name, or part of it

to_time.description: the new start time (HH:MM, on the hour or half hour)

actions.name: booking_check_in
actions.does: Check a group in for a booking that paid a deposit online: how many golfers came. The unit works out each one's share, what the deposit covers (a member's surplus becomes their credit) and what to collect at the door - said back first. Find it by its day and time, bay or the customer's name (today unless said)

date.description: the day of the booking - today unless the owner says

name.description: the customer's name, or part of it

actions.name: booking_cancel
actions.does: Cancel a customer's booking. Find it by its day and its time, bay or the customer's name. Ask the owner which refund before calling - full, half or none - and never choose it yourself; a booking with nothing paid online is none.
