date.description: the day of the booking; leave out to look through the customer's upcoming bookings by name

name.description: the customer's name, or part of it

refund_type.description: exactly what the owner said: full, half or none

actions.name: booking_clear_pending
actions.does: Clear a checkout a customer never finished (a booking shown as "checkout not finished"), so its time can be booked again. Stripe is asked first: if they did pay, nothing is cleared

date.description: the day of the booking

name.description: the customer's name, or part of it

actions.name: blocks_read
actions.does: Look at the blocks: bays (or the whole facility) taken out of booking for an event, a tournament or maintenance

from.description: from this day on (today when left out)

actions.name: block_add
actions.does: Block off a bay, or close the whole facility, for an event, a tournament or maintenance - customers cannot book it then. Give the day and the hours, or all day; several days with end_date

bay.description: the bay's name, or "whole facility" to close the building

label.description: its name on the calendar, like "Spring league" (optional)

date.description: the first day

end_date.description: the last day, for a block over several days

start_time.description: a time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock (5pm and 5:30 pm are understood too)

end_time.description: a time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock (5pm and 5:30 pm are understood too)

all_day.description: true for the whole opening day (from opening to closing)

actions.name: block_remove
actions.does: Take a block off, so the bay (or the facility) can be booked again then. Find it by a day it covers, and its bay or kind when there are several

date.description: a day the block covers

actions.name: checkin_mode_set
actions.does: Choose how check-in works at the counter: full (staff check people in and settle the group), arrival only (staff mark people as arrived, nothing settled) or off (no check-in at all - most unstaffed facilities)

actions.name: booking_rules_read
actions.does: Look at the booking rules and the facility's details: opening hours, who can book, session lengths, how far ahead, the gap between bookings, the booking flow, cancelling, early bay access, check-in, the time zone, contact details and the legal name

actions.name: booking_rules_set
actions.does: Change the booking rules: the shortest and longest session, how many days ahead customers can book, the minutes kept free between bookings, and whether customers pick a bay first or a time first

days_ahead.description: how far ahead customers can book: 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180 or 365 days

buffer_minutes.description: minutes kept free between bookings: 0, 5, 10, 15 or 30

customers_pick.description: bay_first: customers pick their bay; time_first: they pick a time and a bay is given at checkout

actions.name: members_only_set
actions.does: Make booking members only (a private club: a current member code is needed to book online) or open to the public again

actions.name: whole_facility_set
actions.does: Choose whether one booking takes one bay (customers pick a bay) or the whole facility (a venue rented as one: one booking takes every bay)

actions.name: contact_info_set

street_address.description: like "123 Main St" (the city, state and ZIP are the location, set apart)

hours_text.description: the hours as words at the top of the booking page, like "Open daily 9 AM - 11 PM" (the hours customers can book are the opening hours)

actions.name: company_name_set

actions.name: menu_item_sold_out

actions.name: menu_part_change
actions.does: Change one part of the menu (Beer, Food...): rename it, put it before or after another part, where its tickets print, its tax (said back first), or switch it off (off the pads and the website) and on again

actions.name: counter_special_remove
actions.does: Take a counter special off for good - the pad goes back to the menu's prices for it, and the website stops showing it

actions.name: deal_remove
actions.does: Take a booking deal off for good (bookings already made keep the price they were charged)

actions.name: package_set
actions.does: Make a package deal - bay time and what comes with it at one price: "2 hours and a pitcher for $60", "birthday party: 2 hours, a pizza and 2 drinks each, $25 a person, 6 to 10 people", "corporate: 3 hours, $40 a person" - or change one (package: its name now). Its price and its tax only as the owner said them - otherwise call without them and the box asks

package.description: to change a package that is there already: its name now

hours.description: its bay time in hours (0.5 to 4)

price.description: the price in dollars - or a person's, when per_person

per_person.description: true when the price is a person's

what.description: a menu item by name, or a part of the menu ("beer" for any beer)

tax.description: "booking" (the bookings' rate), a counter tax code's name (like "Beverage"), or "split:<code name>" (the golf part as a booking, the rest at that code) - only as the owner said it

golf_part.description: split: the golf part of the price in dollars (a person's, when per_person)

at.description: top = right after the top of the page; bottom (the usual) = near the end
